tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search the RateCard Health index of healthcare B2B trade publications, association e-newsletters and journals that publish advertising rate cards. Filter by category (e.g. dental, pharmacy, nursing, health IT), format (e-newsletter, print, dedicated email) and/or a free-text query (name, publisher,

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Public details for one publication: publisher, audience, circulation, open rate/CTR, entry ad unit with price band, names of other ad units, rate-card year, last verified date, official media kit link and page URL. Look up by slug or (partial) name.

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: Aggregate ad-price benchmarks (CC BY 4.0) across healthcare B2B rate cards: median/quartile entry prices and derived CPMs (rounded, or banded; medians only for groups with 5+ rate cards), by format, category and price band. Optionally filter by group_type (all, format, category, entry_price_band) or

tools.name: get_free_sample
tools.description: The 10 free sample rows of the RateCard Health database (full fields, exact prices) — the same rows as the public sample CSV.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the publication categories and format groups covered, with counts and page URLs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_publications, get_publication, list_categories · Private data: get_free_sample · Public sink: search_publications · Destructive: search_publications, get_price_index, list_categories.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_publications, get_publication, list_categories · Private data: get_free_sample · Public sink: search_publications · Destructive: search_publications, get_price_index, list_categories

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
